assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: transparent illustrated wordmark for the subtype header of a Lotería-inspired trading card.
Input image: the approved painted TRADER wordmark, used as the exact lettering style reference and edit target.
Primary request: replace TRADER with "REMEDY", and keep the same painted serif lettering style, warm ochre/gold color, brush texture, stroke weight, and slightly irregular sign-painted character.
Text (verbatim): "REMEDY". Spell exactly R - E - M - E - D - Y. One word on one horizontal baseline.
Style: sturdy classical Roman serif capitals, broad wedge serifs, open counters, gently curved R legs, subtle pale brush highlights; flat painted pigment with restrained texture. Match the reference's letterforms where letters recur.
Composition: wide horizontal wordmark with comfortable clear margins, all letters fully visible. Adjust the natural word width to fit without squeezing or distorting individual letters. Similar cap height throughout; digits 8 and 0 when present must share the same height and painted serif character.
Background: genuinely transparent, with clean alpha around each letter and inside all counters. Output only the lettering.
Avoid: backdrop, plaque, border, card, illustration, flourishes, extra text, gothic/blackletter forms, mosaic tiles, jewel effects, metallic bevel, drop shadow, glow, hazy halos, detached flecks.
